name: toggle_flashlight
description: Turn the phone camera flashlight (torch) on or off.

name: get_battery_status
description: Get the phone battery percentage, charging state, temperature, and health.

name: set_screen_brightness
description: Set the phone screen brightness percentage from 1 to 100, or set mode to auto.

auto.description: True to enable adaptive automatic brightness.

name: set_volume
description: Set the audio volume level for a specific stream (media, ring, alarm, notification, call) from 0 to 100.

name: adjust_setting
description: Nudge the volume or screen brightness up or down by a step percentage.

name: toggle_setting
description: Turn a system setting on or off (wifi, bluetooth, do not disturb, auto rotate, dark mode, hotspot).

name: vibrate_phone
description: Vibrate the phone haptic motor for a specified duration in milliseconds.

name: read_hardware_sensors
description: Read current values from phone hardware sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, ambient light, barometer, proximity).

name: get_wifi_and_network_info
description: Get connected Wi-Fi SSID, IP address, signal strength, cellular operator, and network type.

name: get_gps_location
description: Get the phone's current GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude, altitude, accuracy, and reverse-geocoded address).
triggers: \b(where am i|my location|gps coordinates|current location|find my phone)\b

name: send_sms
description: Send an SMS text message to a phone number or contact name.

recipient.description: Contact name or phone number, e.g. '+919876543210' or 'Sam'.

name: read_recent_sms
description: Read recent incoming SMS messages, optionally filtered by sender or category (all, otp, bank, personal).

name: extract_latest_otp
description: Find the latest verification code / OTP from recent SMS or notifications and copy it to the clipboard.

name: call_contact
description: Initiate a phone call to a contact name or phone number.

target.description: Contact name or phone number to call, e.g. 'Mom' or '+15550199'.

name: search_contacts
description: Search the phone's contact book by name, organization, or phone number.

query.description: Name or keyword to search in contacts.

name: speak_aloud
description: Speak a message out loud through the phone speaker using on-device Text-to-Speech (TTS).

name: control_media
description: Control currently playing media or music (play, pause, resume, next, previous, stop).

name: take_photo
description: Capture a photo silently using the rear or front camera and send it back to Telegram.

name: record_audio_clip
description: Record an audio clip from the phone microphone for a given duration in seconds and send to Telegram.

name: open_app
description: Launch an installed application on the phone by its common name.

app_name.description: Application name such as WhatsApp, YouTube, Chrome, Maps, Spotify, Settings, Camera, Gmail, Telegram.

name: open_website
description: Open a URL or website in the phone's default browser.

url.description: Web address such as github.com or https://cactuscompute.com/needle.

name: set_alarm_or_timer
description: Set a system alarm for a specific time (e.g. '07:00') or start a countdown timer (e.g. '10 minutes').

value.description: Time like '07:30' for alarm, or duration like '10 minutes' for timer.

name: take_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the current phone screen via AccessibilityService and send it to Telegram.

name: ui_screen_action
description: Perform an on-screen UI automation action via AccessibilityService: click text/button, type text, scroll, or press system keys (home, back, recents, lock).

target_or_text.description: Button label to click or text string to type.

name: clipboard_manager
description: Read the current phone clipboard text or copy new text to the clipboard.

text.description: Text to copy when operation is 'write'.

name: extract_structured_data
description: Use Needle 3 grammar-constrained extraction to parse unstructured text (receipts, invoices, contact cards, alerts) into structured fields.

name: save_memory_note
description: Embed and store a personal note, credential, or fact in the on-device SQLite vector knowledge vault using Needle 3 3072-dim embeddings.

content.description: The note or fact to remember locally.

name: search_memory_vault
description: Semantically search the local on-device SQLite knowledge vault using Needle 3 embeddings (needle_embed).
